pages-exchange may load
vendor-mapbox should NOT load on initial page load
vendor-maplibre should NOT load on initial page load
passCriteria: vendor-mapbox JS is not loaded before map UI is requested.
vendor-mapbox CSS is not loaded before map UI is requested.

routeGroups.label: MapLibre Surfaces

passCriteria: MapLibre is not loaded on unrelated pages.
MapLibre visual routes render correctly when opened.
